summary: Verified NOT ON PAR at 7.0/10 (reviewer 7.1). No sensitivity blocker: crown gate passes on all 3 GLBs (R3 15.0 cm, dome 0.75), the hood is rounded, the face is folded wrapped cloth under a carved band (not horror/mannequin), and no Wick content is involved. All three majors reproduce on the cited artifacts: splashes are posterized cut-outs (grain 7.6-7.8 vs plate 0.6-2.2, LE white halo, 54-66% orange hands), the run's lifted dark thigh crosses in front of the pale front skirt panel (run f1), and from behind the shoulder plates read as dark translucent fins. One correction to M1: the brief (ulkro.md:176) stages the base splash as the victory clip with the horizon hand raised and the crest to screen-right, not a 'release beat'; the base card still misses it (thrower low, no raised hand). Minor m4 is refuted: the final death frame shows her on her back with knees bent and soles toward the floor, chest strap facing up, as the brief asks. Tail pop (m1) reproduces in the per-frame data (seg2 -53.7 -> +20.5, +36.6 -> -53.4). Frame timing not measured (load 6-9, not needed).

findings.title: All three splashes are posterized model cut-outs on painted plates, with a halo, orange hands and a passive base pose
findings.what: Figure is a filtered 3D render pasted on a soft painted plate: blocky posterized patches, white cut-out halo on Long Evening, no shared light or ground/cast shadow (Highrim leap floats), saturated orange hands are the hottest mass on every card. Base card is a near-frontal stand with the thrower low and pointing down.
findings.evidence: _harness/_reports/closing_ulkro2_splash_grain.txt (figure 7.60/7.79/7.78 vs sky 0.98/0.77/0.62, ground 2.18/1.94/1.43); _harness/_reports/closing_ulkro2_splash_hands.txt (#c87d56 57%, LE 61-63%, portrait 66%); _harness/_shots/closing_ulkro2_le_splash_head_x3.png (halo + posterized blocks, re-viewed); art/out/fighters/ulkro/splash.png, ulkro_highrim_splash.png, ulkro_long_evening_splash.png (all 11-04, re-viewed downscaled).
findings.gauge: A current LoL splash is one painted action beat where figure and backdrop share light, edges and brushwork; no sticker halo, no floating figure.
findings.fix: Re-stage the base card per the brief's own SPLASH entry (ulkro.md:176: victory beat, horizon hand raised, thrower over the shoulder, crest fanning screen-right) on the dial rim in dusk key light; render the figure in the plate's key/fill with a contact/cast shadow pass; alpha-erode the matte; replace posterize with a painted-over pass at plate stroke scale (figure grain within 2x of plate); grade hands to ~35% saturation; re-cut portraits.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced visually and from the reports. Corrected the reviewer's brief citation: the brief asks for a victory pose with the horizon hand raised, not a 'release beat'; the base card still misses it. Severity major holds (cards are store/loading-facing, below the gauge, but not a blocker).

findings.title: Run: the lifted dark thigh still breaks through the front skirt panel
findings.what: On the lifted-leg run frames the dark legging thigh renders in front of the pale skirt_f panel as a horizontal dark bar; the new 2-bone skirt chain swings only 22.5 deg against a thigh reaching +81.8 deg.
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing_ulkro2_clip_run_f1f2_x2.png (left frame: thigh crossing the skirt front, re-viewed); _harness/_reports/closing_ulkro2_chains.txt (run skirt_f seg1 max +53.3, swing 22.5; thigh.L +81.8 at f15).
findings.gauge: A LoL champion's long skirt/tabard stays in front of the legs through the run; the knee pushes the cloth, the leg never shows through.
findings.fix: Drive skirt_f_1 from the leading thigh angle (~0.8x) with the 2-frame lag, floor the panel angle at thigh angle minus 10 deg in the clip writer, strip thigh weights from the front panel, and gate with a thigh-vs-skirt_f plane z-order check on run/cast_ult/dash.
findings.verifierNote: Visible on a looping run clip at the close/select camera; at the 108 px gameplay size it is small, so major (not blocker) is right.

findings.title: Shoulder plates are thin shells that read as dark translucent fins from behind
findings.what: From behind the plates' thin back faces show as dark grey curved fins past the arms (bat-wing read); from the front they are pale, near-unshaded slabs, not chunky stone.
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing_ulkro2_back_shoulders_x2.png (left: grey fins either side of the quiver; right: flat pale plate, re-viewed); _harness/_shots/closing_ulkro2_row3_close.png; sheet _harness/_shots/closing_ulkro2_three.png row 3.
findings.gauge: A LoL armour piece has visible thickness and a lit rim from every side and reads as one material at any angle.
findings.fix: Solidify each tier 2.5-3 cm with a painted chisel bevel, paint inner/back faces the same pale stone one value step down, bevel the outer lip so the back silhouette is a rounded stone edge; keep #B3AEA2.
findings.verifierNote: Back view reproduced on the cited shot. Kept major because it changes the silhouette read from behind (common in lane when chasing), though it is not a sensitivity issue.

findings.title: Hood tail snaps 74-90 degrees in one frame during Bound and dash
findings.what: cast_a2 tail seg2 goes -53.7, +20.5, +36.6, -53.4 across f3-f6; dash max step 89.1 deg.
findings.gauge: LoL secondary chains overshoot and settle smoothly even on dashes.
findings.fix: Clamp the tail spring step to ~35 deg/frame and raise seg2 rebound damping.
findings.verifierNote: Values are not an angle wrap (steps of 74 and 90 deg, not ~360); real pop on a short ribbon, minor.

findings.title: The face has no living cue at chip and portrait size
findings.what: Matte brown band over a pale wrapped oval in portraits, icon and chips; no glint or eye line.
findings.gauge: A wrapped/masked LoL champion still reads as someone looking out at icon size.
findings.fix: Open a narrow dark recess at the band's lower edge with a warm catch-light (owner ruling 2) and tuck the wrap's top edge under the band.
findings.verifierNote: Not a sensitivity issue: the wrap has visible folds and sits inside a rounded hood with a carved band; it does not read as a blank mannequin or hockey mask.

findings.title: Accent 0.49% keeps the team read faint on the figure
findings.gauge: LoL team read lives in the ring/bar; small model accents still help identity at range.
findings.fix: Widen dart-head veins and add a team-tinted stitch on the quiver strap toward ~1%.
findings.verifierNote: Brief-sanctioned and warning-only; minor is the ceiling.

findings.title: Death ends face-down, not on her back with the knee up
findings.what: Claim: she ends on her front with boots raised behind.
findings.evidence: Final frame of _harness/_shots/closing_ulkro2_clip_death.png, zoomed 3x: chest strap and face side up, head resting back, both knees bent with soles toward the floor, darts spilled to her right, thrower in hand. This matches ulkro.md:123 (rolls onto her back, knee bent up, darts spill to one side).
findings.gauge: LoL death poses read clearly as a final rest authored to the character.
findings.verifierNote: Refuted on the reviewer's own shot: she is on her back. Floor is clean (-0.007 m per closing_ulkro2_floor.txt).
